findings.title: SIGTERM and SIGINT both abort the worker with SIGABRT (exit 134) instead of stopping it, because the trap calls GRPC::RpcServer#stop which synchronizes in a trap context
findings.recommendation: Make the handler trap-safe by deferring, the way bin/tamoz-stream-subscriber:78-83 already does: the trap sets a flag and the normal-context caller performs server.stop. Then assert the exit status at test/stream_worker_server_test.rb:126-127. WorkerServer#stop's logic stays as it is.
